title: Black Panther Aggression: Vibranium Ambush
summary: This build clears schemes with cheap aggression thwarts and Wakandan allies while stacking attack events and combat upgrades for steady damage. Economy comes from Vibranium, Helicarrier, and aggression resources so you can chain strikes without stalling. Dora Milaje support and the royal kit keep the board stable as you finish villains.
